item.title: LIV Golf paid $15 million to retain executives before filing for bankruptcy, court records show
item.description: LIV Golf has paid $15.6 million to retain seven executives in the three months before filing for bankruptcy. That includes $6.375 million to CEO Scott O'Neil.

item.title: Six Flags says it will install seat belts on Georgia roller coaster after rider's death
